Materials Horizons | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using interface engineering to address poor interfacial contact, lithium dendrite formation, and unstable electrode–electrolyte interfaces in solid-state batteries. Its significance is enabling high-current-density solid-state lithium metal batteries, a key step toward practical, high-energy-density solid-state battery technology.
